topic: A father's dignity is worth more than any money
title: रिक्शे वाले की बेटी
setting: A small north Indian town in winter, a government school with a yellow building and a tin-roofed stage decorated with marigolds and paper bunting, soft afternoon light turning golden

characters.name: मुन्नी
characters.look: a cheerful 10-year-old Indian girl, two neat plaits tied with red ribbons, big brown eyes, navy blue school pinafore over a white shirt, red cardigan, black school shoes

characters.name: पापा
characters.look: a thin cycle-rickshaw puller in his 40s, sun-browned skin, short black hair, a few days of stubble, faded green half-sleeve shirt, grey checked towel over one shoulder, brown trousers, worn rubber chappals

characters.name: प्रिंसिपल मैडम
characters.look: a kind school principal in her 50s, silver hair in a low bun, round gold-rimmed glasses, maroon cotton sari with a cream border, a small bindi

hook.line: उस दिन पूरे स्कूल में सबसे पीछे एक रिक्शा खड़ा था।
hook.roman: Us din poore school mein sabse peeche ek rickshaw khada tha.
hook.image: a wide view of a crowded school annual day ground, shiny cars parked at the front, one old cycle rickshaw parked alone at the very back near the gate, golden afternoon light

beats.line: स्कूल का सालाना जलसा था और हर बच्चे के माँ-बाप आए थे।
beats.roman: School ka saalana jalsa tha aur har bachche ke maa-baap aaye the.
beats.image: parents in neat clothes filling rows of plastic chairs in front of a marigold-decorated stage, children in costumes running around

beats.line: मुन्नी बार-बार गेट की तरफ देख रही थी।
beats.roman: Munni baar-baar gate ki taraf dekh rahi thi.
beats.image: munni stands on tiptoe near the stage steps, looking anxiously towards the school gate

beats.line: फिर पसीने में भीगे पापा अंदर आए।
beats.roman: Phir paseene mein bheege papa andar aaye.
beats.image: papa walks in through the school gate wiping his sweaty face with his towel, people in the last row glance at him

beats.line: वो चुपचाप सबसे आखिरी कुर्सी पर बैठ गए।
beats.roman: Woh chupchaap sabse aakhiri kursi par baith gaye.
beats.image: papa sits alone on the very last plastic chair, shoulders small, holding his towel, far from the other parents

beats.line: कुछ लोग उन्हें देखकर मुँह फेरने लगे।
beats.roman: Kuch log unhe dekhkar munh pherne lage.
beats.image: two well-dressed parents in the row ahead turn away from papa with raised eyebrows, papa looks down at his chappals

beats.line: पापा ने अपनी फटी चप्पल कुर्सी के नीचे छुपा ली।
beats.roman: Papa ne apni phati chappal kursi ke neeche chhupa li.
beats.image: a close detail of worn rubber chappals with a broken strap being pushed under a plastic chair

beats.line: तभी मंच से प्रिंसिपल मैडम की आवाज़ आई।
beats.roman: Tabhi manch se principal madam ki awaaz aayi.
beats.image: madam stands at the microphone on the marigold-decorated stage holding a gold trophy, the crowd looking up at her

beats.line: इस साल की सबसे होनहार छात्रा है, मुन्नी!
beats.roman: Is saal ki sabse honhaar chhatra hai, Munni!
beats.image: munni gasps with joy as the crowd claps, confetti in the golden light

beats.line: मुन्नी मंच पर गई, पर ट्रॉफी लेने से पहले रुक गई।
beats.roman: Munni manch par gayi, par trophy lene se pehle ruk gayi.
beats.image: munni on the stage stops in front of madam and the trophy, looking out over the crowd towards the back row

beats.line: उसने माइक पकड़ा और कहा, मेरे पापा को ऊपर बुलाइए।
beats.roman: Usne mic pakda aur kaha, mere papa ko upar bulaiye.
beats.image: munni holds the microphone with both hands and points to the last row, the whole crowd turns around

beats.line: पूरा मैदान पीछे मुड़कर उस रिक्शे वाले को देखने लगा।
beats.roman: Poora maidan peeche mudkar us rickshaw wale ko dekhne laga.
beats.image: papa stands up slowly in the last row, surprised and shy, every head in the crowd turned towards him

beats.line: पापा काँपते पैरों से मंच तक पहुँचे।
beats.roman: Papa kaanpte pairon se manch tak pahunche.
beats.image: papa climbs the stage steps barefoot, holding his towel, munni waiting with open arms

beats.line: मुन्नी ने ट्रॉफी उनके हाथों में रख दी।
beats.roman: Munni ne trophy unke haathon mein rakh di.
beats.image: a close detail of munni's small hands placing the gold trophy into papa's rough hands

beats.line: बोली, रोज़ सुबह यही रिक्शा मुझे यहाँ तक लाता है।
beats.roman: Boli, roz subah yahi rickshaw mujhe yahan tak laata hai.
beats.image: munni smiles up at papa on the stage, his eyes filling with tears, madam smiling behind them

beats.line: उस दिन सबसे ज़्यादा तालियाँ आखिरी कुर्सी वाले के लिए बजीं।
beats.roman: Us din sabse zyaada taaliyan aakhiri kursi wale ke liye bajin.
beats.image: the whole crowd standing and clapping for papa and munni on the stage, golden evening light, marigold petals in the air

moral.line: क्योंकि याद रखना, इज़्ज़त कपड़ों से नहीं, मेहनत से मिलती है।
moral.roman: Kyunki yaad rakhna, izzat kapdon se nahi, mehnat se milti hai.
moral.image: papa pedals his rickshaw home at sunset with munni sitting proudly in the back holding the trophy high

ask: आपको अपने पापा की कौन सी मेहनत याद है?
ask_roman: Aapko apne papa ki kaun si mehnat yaad hai?
